description: This file defines a mock class called MockINetworkManager for the INetworkManager interface, using Google Mock. It includes mock methods for network management operations such as interface configuration, WiFi management, IP settings, and connectivity tests.

classes.name: MockINetworkManager
classes.description: A mock implementation of the INetworkManager interface, providing mock methods for unit testing network-related functionalities.

methods.name: GetAvailableInterfaces
methods.description: Retrieves available network interfaces.

methods.name: GetPrimaryInterface
methods.description: Fetches the primary network interface.

methods.name: SetInterfaceState
methods.description: Enables or disables a specified network interface.

methods.name: GetInterfaceState
methods.description: Checks if a network interface is enabled.

methods.name: GetIPSettings
methods.description: Retrieves IP settings for a specified interface.

methods.name: SetIPSettings
methods.description: Sets IP settings for a specified interface.

methods.name: GetStunEndpoint
methods.description: Gets the STUN server endpoint configuration.

methods.name: SetStunEndpoint
methods.description: Sets the STUN server endpoint configuration.

methods.name: GetConnectivityTestEndpoints
methods.description: Retrieves endpoints used for connectivity testing.

methods.name: SetConnectivityTestEndpoints
methods.description: Sets endpoints used for connectivity testing.

methods.name: IsConnectedToInternet
methods.description: Checks internet connectivity status.

methods.name: GetCaptivePortalURI
methods.description: Gets the URI of the captive portal.

methods.name: GetPublicIP
methods.description: Retrieves the public IP address.

methods.name: Ping
methods.description: Performs a network ping to a specified endpoint.

methods.name: Trace
methods.description: Performs a network trace route to a specified endpoint.

methods.name: StartWiFiScan
methods.description: Starts scanning for WiFi networks.

methods.name: StopWiFiScan
methods.description: Stops ongoing WiFi scan.

methods.name: GetKnownSSIDs
methods.description: Retrieves list of known WiFi SSIDs.

methods.name: AddToKnownSSIDs
methods.description: Adds a WiFi SSID to the known list.

methods.name: RemoveKnownSSID
methods.description: Removes a WiFi SSID from the known list.

methods.name: WiFiConnect
methods.description: Connects to a WiFi network.

methods.name: WiFiDisconnect
methods.description: Disconnects from the current WiFi network.

methods.name: GetConnectedSSID
methods.description: Gets info about the currently connected WiFi SSID.

methods.name: StartWPS
methods.description: Starts WPS pairing process.

methods.name: StopWPS
methods.description: Stops WPS pairing process.

methods.name: GetWifiState
methods.description: Retrieves current WiFi state.

methods.name: GetWiFiSignalQuality
methods.description: Retrieves WiFi signal quality metrics.

methods.name: GetSupportedSecurityModes
methods.description: Lists supported security modes.

methods.name: SetLogLevel
methods.description: Configures logging level.

methods.name: SetHostname
methods.description: Sets device hostname.

methods.name: GetLogLevel
methods.description: Retrieves current logging level.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures network settings via a line command.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a network notification callback.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a network notification callback.
